messages:
maria_sales: Nimbus POC next week. Customer expects baseline ~120 qps, short spikes to ~320 qps for 8-12m every 45m. Workload: chat + occasional bulk embeddings. Model: rwd-70b-qat. Need reserved GPU rec, autoscale knobs, KV/preheat steps, and a quick pricing delta.

sam_se: Is spike pattern predictable? any tail-latency SLOs?

maria_sales: Spikes are semi-predictable (cron-like peaks). SLO: p95 < 500ms.

alex_dev: Recommend reserved pool 3x A100 for baseline, autoscale to 8 for peak buffer (prewarmed 2 nodes). Continuous batching + KV cache for common prompts.

alex_dev: Autoscale snippet (example): min=3, max=8, policy=queue+token_rate, up_threshold=0.7, cooldown=25s. Use prewarmed standby to shave cold-starts.

sam_se: Preheat plan: run prefix warmup for top 12 prompts 90-120m before demo; run embeddings warmup once. Command: `./ops/preheat --model rwd-70b-qat --batch 32 --prompts top12.txt`.

jordan_fin: Ballpark pricing: 3 reserved A100 ~ $14k/mo, burst credits to 8 ~ +$5k/mo at expected usage. On-demand only ~2x. I'll formalize in quote.

ops_oncall: Add AZ spread for resilience. Also include an auto-fallback to rwd-30b for non-critical calls. Add audit-log text for their security questionnaire.

maria_sales: Thanks all. Can someone open the capacity ticket and draft the runbook? Meeting in 45 to review.

billing-bot: Created quote draft Q-6821 and placeholder ticket INF-2199 for Nimbus POC capacity prep assigned to alex_dev.
